name: Fix gem shadows and the watcher's light
body: Dean's Mac play-test: the gems' shadows show as odd dark specks on the floor, and the watcher's light was barely visible at night.

comments.text: Filed 2026-11-16 before any code. Plan: gems stop casting shadows (D-094); the watcher gets an amber beam, a glowing housing and a lit floor patch (D-095).

acceptance_criteria: The watcher's beam, lamp and floor patch read clearly at night
